quests.name: Minister as the Lord
quests.first_part_description: Reach out and minister to those assigned to you at least
quests.second_part_description: times each month. Consistent ministering helps build unity, provides support, and follows the Savior's example of love.

quests.name: Study Conference Talks
quests.second_part_description: talks from the most recent General Conference each month. Studying the words of living prophets and apostles will inspire, guide, and strengthen your faith.

quests.name: Attend the Temple
quests.second_part_description: times this month to participate in ordinances. Regular temple attendance brings peace, spiritual strength, and opportunities to serve.

quests.name: Study Patriarchal Blessing
quests.first_part_description: Study your patriarchal blessing at least
quests.second_part_description: this month. Regular reflection on your blessing will help you understand your divine potential and receive personal guidance.
